title: MarshalConformanceMatrixRow
description: The dict shape core.conformance.build_matrix_row() produces (Story 6.6, FR-45/SM-6/AD-31/AD-37): one adapter's accumulated conformance-matrix row -- status, adapter version, harness version, date, failing stage, and whether the row is stale. additionalProperties is false, matching gate-record.json's/policy.json's own closed-schema discipline. jsonschema validates this document only in tests (src/ never runtime-validates against it, matching gate-record.json's own precedent).

status.description: The FOURTH, independent closed status vocabulary this story adds (AD-31) -- never conflated with the tree-drift, probe-availability, or smoke-run vocabularies core/conformance.py also declares, even where a string literal coincides. "not-attempted" means no claim is made at all; SM-6 counts only "pass".

adapter_version.description: The adapter binary's own reported version, from the most recent probe record, or null if never probed or unavailable.

harness_version.description: The bmad-loop version that ran the smoke this row reports, or null if no smoke record exists.

date.description: The UTC ISO-8601 instant the underlying smoke record was written (core.conformance.build_smoke_record's own recorded_at), or null if no smoke record exists or it carries no parseable timestamp.

failing_stage.description: The smoke's own failing stage (core.conformance.SMOKE_STAGES) when status is "fail"; null otherwise.

stale.description: True iff date parses and is older than the caller's configured staleness threshold. Always false for "not-attempted" (no claim exists to age) and for a missing/unparseable date -- never fabricated.
